title: Laredo Fire Department Shares Thanksgiving Cooking Fire Safety Tips
excerpt: Thanksgiving is the peak day of the year for home cooking fires, and the Laredo Fire Department is urging residents to stay in the kitchen while cooking, fry turkeys outdoors only, test smoke alarms, and never throw water on a grease fire.
content:
The Laredo Fire Department is asking Laredo to take a few precautions before Thanksgiving so the holiday stays safe and quiet.

Thanksgiving is the peak day of the year for home cooking fires, the department said Wednesday, Nov. 25, in a safety message ahead of the holiday on Thursday, Nov. 26.

Stay in the kitchen while food is cooking, the department said, and never leave cooking food or open flames unattended. Keep towels and paper products away from burners.

For anyone deep-frying a turkey, do it outdoors only, on a flat surface away from structures. Make sure the bird is completely thawed and dry, do a water test first so the oil does not overflow, and shut off the burner before lowering the turkey in.

Test smoke alarms before cooking, keep a fire extinguisher nearby, and never throw water on a grease fire. Smother it with a lid and turn off the heat instead.

Sources: Laredo Fire Department, Nov. 25, 2026.
